scope: Local sample policy, never real organizational authority or external effects
invariants: SQLite durable transaction: decision and one audit row atomic
Identical key/content retry reuses original response and adds no audit; changed content/key identity conflict is rejected
Expected version guards updates: two real processes at same original version yield one commit and one conflict
Controlled direct-process crash before commit rolls back; retry uses same original request
Every outcome explains rule and fixed policy version; no actual approvals or notifications
acceptance: Original batch matches original explicit rules
Restart/idempotency/input validation/late rollback/cancellation-free concurrency preserve original state and audit
Successor local manual-review task actually starts on retained manual entries
